Join EastWest Bank's IT & Digital Solutions Internship Program for hands-on experience in technology and digital innovation within banking.

Your Role
Here's what you will be doing:

Participate in IT projects, systems support, automation, and development tasks.
Work onsite at PBCom Tower Makati in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Collaborate with EastWest's technology and data professionals for mentorship and guidance.
About You
The company is looking for:

Students currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or any related course.
Strong academic standing with a passion for innovation.
Digitally savvy, analytical, and detail-oriented individuals.
Eagerness to gain real-world experience in a highly collaborative setting.
Compensation & Benefits
This is a paid internship.
Mentorship from experienced technology and data professionals.
A supportive and collaborative workplace that values growth and learning.
